highlights: Mandatory staff reporting procedures for mistreatment or neglect
Counseling Department intervention and case management
Compliance with the Child Protection Act 2003 and Thai Constitution
safety.policy_summary: Wells International School enforces a comprehensive Safeguarding and Child Protection Policy to ensure all students are free from abuse, neglect, or mistreatment. All faculty and staff are legally and ethically obligated to report any suspicion of harm to designated administrators and campus leaders, supported by the Counseling Department and general affairs management.
